thread:
sam_t: 👋 Heads-up — customer reported duplicate tool executions and unexpected billing spike. They saw the tool run twice (two emails sent) after a transient error. Root looks like retries + fallback combo. Repro below.

anya: can you paste the request + logs?

sam_t: payload: ```json
{
  "model": "gpt-4o",
  "functions": [{
    "name": "send_email",
    "parameters": {"to": "user@example.com", "body": "hi"}
  }],
  "max_retries": 2
}
``` logs (trimmed): 
"HTTP 502 from tool-host at 2024-12-03T13:22:10Z" then "202 Accepted from fallback-runner at 2024-12-03T13:22:12Z" then "200 OK from tool-host at 2024-12-03T13:22:14Z"

mike: reading that — looks like a timing window: client/library retries on 502, our router falls back to the non-tool execution path, and both paths ultimately succeed. No idempotency key on tool invocation so duplicate action executed. Also saw intermittent 401 earlier in request chain (auth refresh race).

christine: customer also emailed billing — saw two message charges flagged. We should pause billing until we have a remediation plan.

sre_josh: taking ownership. Quick mitigation: disable automatic fallback for this tenant and flip retries to idempotent-only for tool calls. Will open an incident.

support_bot: Incident created: INC-2026 (priority=P2) — assigned to eng-runtime and billing.

sam_t: repro steps I used: 1) send request that calls send_email function 2) induce a 502 from tool-host on first try 3) client/library retries immediately 4) our routing policy triggers fallback path (non-tool) because the tool-host status looks unhealthy 5) both fallback-runner and tool-host later return success -> double send. Suggest adding required idempotency-key header on function invocation and treat 202 as success for tool-host to avoid retrying.

anya: checking logs: the function invocation headers show no X-Request-Id or Idempotency-Key. Could we make the SDK auto-add idempotency-key for function calls? Also, enforce in service: if no idempotency-key present, tag invocation as non-idempotent and suppress automatic fallback/retry concurrency.

mike: deployed hotfix branch: treat upstream 202 as terminal success (stop retries) and add a short-circuit that prevents fallback if a request is mid-flight without idempotency token. Rolling out to canary now.

christine: I put a billing hold and issued a provisional refund for the customer. Will follow up with an email explaining remediation and ask if they want a deeper postmortem.

sam_t: thanks. After hotfix stabilizes we should add unit tests and an e2e that simulates combined retry+fallback behaviour. Also add observability: metric for duplicate-tool-executions by tenant.

sre_josh: noted. Assigning follow-ups: ENG-Runtime to finish dedupe support, ENG-Platform to add idempotency requirement in SDKs, Billing to finalize refunds. :white_check_mark:

mike: rollback plan ready if canary fails. Will update status in the incident.

sam_t: appreciated — will keep this thread as the single source of truth for comms with customer.
